questions.title: MVP (Most Valuable Player)
questions.description: At the end of the session, vote for the character who made the most critical and meaningful contributions. Exactly one winner receives 10 points; the GM breaks any tie.

givePointReasons.title: Good Ideas
givePointReasons.description: Award points for good ideas during the session.

givePointReasons.title: Meaningful Participation
givePointReasons.description: Award points for important contributions during the session, especially those advancing the story.

givePointReasons.title: Session Attendance
givePointReasons.description: Award points for attending the session.

givePointReasons.title: Punctuality
givePointReasons.description: Award points for arriving on time.

givePointReasons.title: Notable Roleplay
givePointReasons.description: Award 1 point for notable character roleplay, up to 5 points per session. The GM tracks this per-session limit.

givePointReasons.title: Previous Session Achievements
givePointReasons.description: Achievements based on events from the previous session, suggested by players and subject to GM approval.

redeemBenefits.name: Advantage Before a Roll
redeemBenefits.description: Gain advantage on one d20 roll. Declare this before rolling.

redeemBenefits.name: Extra d20 Before the Outcome
redeemBenefits.description: Roll an additional d20 after the initial roll, but before you learn whether it succeeded or failed.

redeemBenefits.name: +5 After Rolling, Before the Outcome
redeemBenefits.description: Add +5 to a d20 roll after seeing the roll, but before learning whether it succeeded or failed.

redeemBenefits.name: +10 Initiative
redeemBenefits.description: Add +10 to your initiative for a combat. May only be used immediately after initiative is rolled.

redeemBenefits.name: Bless for 1 Day
redeemBenefits.description: Gain the effects of Bless for 1 day.

redeemBenefits.name: +5 After the Outcome
redeemBenefits.description: Add +5 to a d20 roll after seeing the roll and after learning the outcome.

redeemBenefits.name: Maximize Hit Dice During a Rest
redeemBenefits.description: Maximize all Hit Dice rolled during a rest.

redeemBenefits.name: Redraw Noble and Common Cards
redeemBenefits.description: Draw both deck cards (Noble and Common) again. Only at the start of a session.

redeemBenefits.name: Recover One Exhaustion Level
redeemBenefits.description: Recover one level of exhaustion.

redeemBenefits.name: Negate a Bad Luck Card
redeemBenefits.description: Negate the effect of one bad luck card.

redeemBenefits.name: Halve Damage
redeemBenefits.description: Reduce one instance of damage by half.

redeemBenefits.name: Party-wide Bless for 1 Day
redeemBenefits.description: Grant the entire party the effects of Bless for 1 day.

redeemBenefits.name: Personal Bless for 3 Days
redeemBenefits.description: Gain the effects of Bless for yourself for 3 days.

redeemBenefits.name: Choose a Natural 20
redeemBenefits.description: Choose a natural 20 for a die roll.

redeemBenefits.name: Automatic Saving Throw Success
redeemBenefits.description: Choose to succeed on a saving throw.

redeemBenefits.name: Party-wide Bless for 3 Days
redeemBenefits.description: Grant the entire party the effects of Bless for 3 days.

redeemBenefits.name: Advantage on a Level-up Hit Die
redeemBenefits.description: Roll a Hit Die with advantage at your next level-up.

redeemBenefits.name: Significant Character Sheet Change
redeemBenefits.description: Make a significant change to your character sheet while leveling up or after a major tragedy experienced by the character. A narrative reason is required.

redeemBenefits.name: Fortuitous Encounter
redeemBenefits.description: Within the next 10 in-game days, the character gains a fortunate encounter chosen by the GM: finding a needed item, avoiding deadly danger, or meeting an important NPC. This advances only the story of the character who redeemed it.

redeemBenefits.name: Tool Proficiency
redeemBenefits.description: Gain proficiency with one tool of your choice. Once per character.

redeemBenefits.name: Maximize One Previous Hit Die
redeemBenefits.description: Maximize one of your previously gained Hit Dice of your choice, permanently increasing your maximum hit points.

redeemBenefits.name: Increase an Ability Score by +1
redeemBenefits.description: Increase one of your ability scores by +1. Once per character.

redeemBenefits.name: Maximize All Previous Hit Dice
redeemBenefits.description: Maximize all of your previously gained Hit Dice, permanently increasing your maximum hit points.
